summary: Broad risk-on trend day into jobs Friday. Nasdaq closed up 1.23 percent at 29,502.75 and reclaimed the 29,500 round. The S&P rose 1.05 percent to 7,749.5 and printed fresh highs. Gold led, up 1.93 percent to 4,520, and crude added 1.16 percent to 91.68. VIX fell almost 6 percent to 14.32. Stocks, gold, and bonds all caught a bid together, a dovish mix that points to softer rate expectations. It all happened the day before Friday's NFP, so read it as positioning into the number.
psychology: The trap on a strong trend day right before a big event is chasing. Price ran all day and it is tempting to pile in late, right into Friday's jobs report. If you caught the trend, protect it. If you missed it, wait for a clean pullback instead of buying the high into a number that can gap the open. Keep size sane and let the market come to you.
